args.summary: Completed the OpenSeesPy spine-beam model for the five-span continuous bridge (35+40+40+40+35 m), with six precast C50 T girders per span and the described bearing arrangement. Integrated section properties per girder: A=1.022 m², I=0.85655 m⁴; aggregate girder line properties: A=6.132 m², I=5.13933 m⁴, self-weight 159.432 kN/m. Modal analysis gave first vertical frequency f1=3.485 Hz and JTG D60-2015 impact factor μ=0.2049. Model generation succeeded with L1 topology, L2 code, and L3 mechanics checks. Calculated self-weight midspan moments were 10,034–13,043 kN·m; lane-load section envelope was +11,938 kN·m and −9,610 kN·m.
